capture_method: Actual UI selections and read-back prompt; storage shape reconstructed from observed active-card controls. Prompt equality checked against engine output.
prompt:
CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — Linoone (직구리) personified, normal type. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change.

STYLE: Premium glossy anime promotional key art with clean linework, vivid controlled color, dimensional 2.5D shading and dense but organized clothing and accessory detail. Render the face and outfit at the same polished intensity.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her. Everyday clothing chosen for the scene; her species shows only as a small accessory, a motif on the clothing or a color echo — never armor, never a creature costume. Scene, outfit, pose and camera follow the settings below.

SCENE (chosen):
Expression: chin lifted, brows level, eyes bright and steady, closed-lip smile with a firm mouth
Pose: Capture a clear mid-stride step with believable weight transfer.
Orientation: camera below subject looking upward; obey selected framing
Scene: Sunlit aviation museum event on a glass departure bridge, carrying a small unlettered service case.
Outfit and props: Ivory twill jacket with elbow-length sleeves and brown longitudinal piping, short brown scarf, matching tailored above-knee skirt and cream pumps; tiny stripe-shaped clasp.
Category: Create playful adult event fashion inspired by occupation or roleplay motifs. It must read as a costume made for a stage presentation or themed event, not as an authentic workplace uniform. Use original colours and decorative details — no real institutional insignia, no weapons, no tactical gear. Describe the costume by its tailoring, trim, and props, and show a believable styling or preparation action.
Example scene: a retro flight-attendant-inspired costume with a fitted jacket, scarf, and original airline-style trim, at a themed event
Framing: Environmental long shot: show the complete woman and enough surroundings to establish the activity and location.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
Camera: Vertical 2:3 portrait (1024×1536).
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — more scene-appropriate shoulder, back, midriff or leg exposure; cover chest and pelvis
action_level: balanced — a readable moment of gentle movement, not a ratio of multiple images
source_influence: balanced — a few source color and marking cues integrated into everyday clothing
separates_preference: prefer separates — prefer separate top and bottom unless outfit is explicitly specified

ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no creature beside her, no text, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs; her worn features are costume, never extra limbs.

HANDS: each hand has one thumb and four fingers of natural length, clearly separated, never merged, doubled or extra.
